name: HZ_CONTACTPTS_INT_A
description: The import interface table HZ_CONTACTPTS_INT_A stores information for population into HZ_CONTACT_POINTS table.

columns.name: CONTACTPT_T_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the HZ_CONTACTPTS_INT_A interface record. Internal use only.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: DO_NOT_CONTACT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the user can contact the contact point or not.

columns.name: END_DATE_FLAG
columns.description: This attribute is added to track END_DATE updates done by users

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the HZ_CONTACTPTS_INT_A interface record. Internal use only.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for a Batch

columns.name: CP_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original System ID for the Contact Point

columns.name: CP_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original System Reference for the Contact Point

columns.name: PARTY_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original System ID for the Party

columns.name: PARTY_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original System Reference for the Party

columns.name: SITE_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original System ID for the Site

columns.description: Original System Reference for the Site

columns.description: Original System ID for the Relation

columns.name: REL_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original System Reference for the Relationship

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that the record is marked as primary

columns.name: OVERALL_PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that the record is primary for the overall contact

columns.name: PRIMARY_BY_PURPOSE
columns.description: PRIMARY_BY_PURPOSE

columns.name: INSERT_UPDATE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if a record should be explicitly inserted or updated

columns.name: ACTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the action of insert or update based on matching outcome.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party that owns the contact point

columns.name: PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.description: Party Site that owns the contact point

columns.name: CONTACT_POINT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HZ_CONTACT_POINTS

columns.name: CONTACT_POINT_TYPE
columns.description: Lookup: CONTACT_POINT_TYPE of phone, fax, e-mail, web, telex, instant messaging, or EDI

columns.name: CONTACT_POINT_PURPOSE
columns.description: Contact point type, such as business or personal. Uses the CONTACT_POINT_PURPOSE lookup

columns.name: EDI_ECE_TP_LOCATION_CODE
columns.description: Trading partner location code for EDI Gateway

columns.name: EDI_ID_NUMBER
columns.description: EDI trading partner number for the supplier site

columns.name: EDI_PAYMENT_FORMAT
columns.description: Indicates type of information being transmitted with the funds if using EDI_PAYMENT_METHOD ACH. Valid values are CCD, CCP, CHZ, CTX, PPD, and PPP

columns.name: EDI_PAYMENT_METHOD
columns.description: Indicates how payment is sent to the supplier

columns.name: EDI_REMITTANCE_INSTRUCTION
columns.description: Indicates who will send the remittance advice. Valid values are Banks or Payables systems.

columns.name: EDI_REMITTANCE_METHOD
columns.description: Indicates how remittance advice are sent to the supplier

columns.name: EDI_TP_HEADER_ID
columns.description: EDI transaction header unique identifier

columns.name: EDI_TRANSACTION_HANDLING
columns.description: ANSI standard code for EDI transaction type

columns.name: EFT_PRINTING_PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Printing program identifier

columns.name: EFT_SWIFT_CODE
columns.description: EFT Swift Code

columns.name: EFT_TRANSMISSION_PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Transmission program identifier

columns.name: EFT_USER_NUMBER
columns.description: The number that identifier you as a user of electronic funds transfer service to your bank or clearing organization.

columns.name: EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: E-mail address of the contact point

columns.name: EMAIL_FORMAT
columns.description: Indicates the preferred format for e-mail addressed to this address. For example, HTML or ASCII

columns.name: PHONE_AREA_CODE
columns.description: The area code within a country code

columns.name: PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: International country code for a telephone number. For example, 33 for France

columns.name: PHONE_EXTENSION
columns.description: Additional number addressed after initial connection to an internal telephone system

columns.name: PHONE_LINE_TYPE
columns.description: Lookup code for the type of phone line. For example, general, fax, inbound, or outbound

columns.name: PHONE_NUMBER
columns.description: A telephone number formatted in the local format. The number should not include area code, country code, or extension.

columns.name: RAW_PHONE_NUMBER
columns.description: Unformatted telephone number

columns.name: PHONE_CALLING_CALENDAR
columns.description: The name or code for a calling calendar used with this telephone number

columns.name: TELEX_NUMBER
columns.description: Reference number (usually a telephone number) that TELEX messages are sent to.

columns.name: TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.description: Time zone identifier.

columns.name: URL
columns.description: Uniform resource locator

columns.name: WEB_TYPE
columns.description: The prefix class to a web address. Typically this is either FTP or HTTP

columns.name: INSTANT_MESSENGER_TYPE
columns.description: Instant messaging type such as Yahoo, MSN or ICQ

columns.name: INSTANT_MESSAGING_ADDRESS
columns.description: Instant messaging ID

columns.name: PAGER_TYPE_CODE
columns.description:
PAGER_TYPE_CODE stores the lookup code for the type of pager.
The type of pager determines how the page is received. For example, Tone, Number,  Alphanumeric or two-way.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date enablement column. Default SYSDATE.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date enablement column. Default 31-DEC-4712.

columns.name: RELATIONSHIP_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of a relationship.

columns.name: LAST_CONTACT_DT_TIME
columns.description: Date and time of last contact placed to this contact point.

columns.name: INTERFACE_STATUS
columns.description: Status for the data in the interface table

columns.description: Foreign Key to the Error Table
